items.question: How many extras have been added to bookings in total?
How many different extra options have been added to bookings?
items.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT supplement_id ) AS distinct_extra_count FROM /DMO/BOOK_SUPPL

items.question: How many agencies have at least one trip recorded?
items.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT agency_id ) AS agency_count FROM /DMO/TRAVEL

items.question: How many trips include at least one flight booking?
items.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT travel_id ) AS trip_count FROM /DMO/BOOKING

items.question: On how many different dates are flights scheduled in the first quarter of 2027?
items.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT flight_date ) AS flight_date_count FROM /DMO/FLIGHT WHERE flight_date BETWEEN '20270101' AND '20270331'

items.question: Which 10 cities have the most customers? Show cities, country codes and customer counts, largest count first, then by country code and city.
items.reference_sql: SELECT city, country_code, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM /DMO/CUSTOMER GROUP BY city, country_code ORDER BY customer_count DESCENDING, country_code ASCENDING, city ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

items.question: How many scheduled flights are priced in each currency? Show currency codes and flight counts.
items.reference_sql: SELECT currency_code, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM /DMO/FLIGHT GROUP BY currency_code

items.question: How many cities have airports listed in each country? Show country codes and distinct city counts.
items.reference_sql: SELECT country, COUNT( DISTINCT city ) AS city_count FROM /DMO/AIRPORT GROUP BY country

items.question: How many agencies are based in each country? Show country codes and agency counts.
items.reference_sql: SELECT country_code, COUNT(*) AS agency_count FROM /DMO/AGENCY GROUP BY country_code

items.question: How many trips are booked or planned?
items.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS trip_count FROM /DMO/TRAVEL WHERE status IN ( 'B', 'P' )
